<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Test: does clicking a frame teleport the selected object into it?
# 6x3 is currently selected (W on it) at rows 30-35, cols 30-32.
# Click the 6x3 frame in the top-left panel (interior ~ rows 9-14, cols 9-11).
r = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':11,'col':10}])
print('board_changed:', r.get('board_changed'))
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color']=='N':
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        print('N', min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),'px',n['pixels'])
print('level', current_frame.level, 'step', current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
